title: AIDSO students stage protests in Shahabad and Hosapete in support of ASHAs agitation

ai.summary: AIDSO students in Karnataka staged protests in Shahabad and Hosapete to support ASHAs demanding ₹15,000 monthly honorarium after government failed to implement earlier ₹10,000 promise.

facts.claim: AIDSO students staged protests in Shahabad and Hosapete
facts.quote: Students belonging to the All India Democratic Students’ Organisation (AIDSO) staged protests in Shahabad in Kalaburagi district and Hosapete in Vijayanagara district on Saturday

facts.claim: ASHAs have been protesting for 12 days
facts.quote: ASHAs who have been staging an indefinite protest in Bengaluru for the past 12 days

facts.claim: Government promised ₹10,000 but failed to implement
facts.quote: the State government had promised to provide a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000 following an earlier protest by ASHAs two years ago. "However, the promise had not been fulfilled."
nearly 42,000 ASHAs across Karnataka had been participating in the agitation for the past 12 days
ASHAs are currently receiving only ₹5,000 a month from the State government

ai.background_note: ASHAs are Accredited Social Health Activists, community health workers in India who provide basic healthcare services. They have been demanding higher pay since 2024 after the government failed to implement a previous promise of ₹10,000 monthly.
